text: Program Description This program is based on the basic requirements of training objectives for undergraduate international students majoring in dental surgery in China. According to the requirements of international education in dental surgery, it aims to cultivate high-level dental professionals who master basic knowledge, theories, skills of basic medicine and clinical medicine, and are able to adapt to the demands of international dental talent market, pass the dental licensing examination in their respective countries, and engage in dental medical treatment and preventive health care.
